entries.claim_boundary: On the exact axial ell=2 wave-packet traces at Iminus and Iplus with omega in [1/2,3/4], the action-derived Stokes-oriented Lee-Wald flux Grams are Hermitian, rank three, radical-free and have inertia (1,2,0) for alpha_W>0. Exact uniform bounds give ||a||<=||G a||<=645||a|| in the auxiliary coefficient L2 topology. Stationary local finite-tangential-jet trace-only improvements have vanishing corners, while unrestricted radial/corner improvement invariance and the global scattering population remain open.

dispersion.statement: Exact three-dimensional positive-frequency L2 wave-packet traces are imported separately at Iminus and Iplus.

lee_wald.statement: The frozen action-derived current pulls back to full-rank Stokes-oriented endpoint Grams with zero radical and inertia (1,2,0) throughout the pilot interval for alpha_W>0. Exact Sturm-certified Frobenius bounds make the form a uniformly nondegenerate bounded operator on the auxiliary positive L2 trace topology.

resonance.statement: The exact Volterra corrections have cross-rate decay p>=5 and uniform omega derivatives through order three, closing the current trace/limit interchange.

causal_retarded.statement: No global retarded or horizon-to-infinity scattering map is constructed.

taub_maps.statement: No compact second-order Taub map enters this endpoint audit.
